VBO:0201288.summary: Affectionate with rescue volunteers from her arrival, Springerdoodle Lacy enjoyed rolling over for belly rubs and spending time on laps. Phoenix Animal Rescue described her greeting visitors and dogs at a busy adoption event. Its account identified her as five years old and said her breeder had surrendered her when she was no longer wanted.
VBO:0201288.shortDescription: Phoenix Animal Rescue described Springerdoodle Lacy enjoying laps and belly rubs, and greeting visitors at an adoption event.
